turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
nd is there a time window?

Hi — yes, but there’s a limited window 😊

Here’s how it works:

Under 45 minutes: you can usually cancel it yourself from your order confirmation email using the “Edit or View your order” button
Between 45 minutes and 1 hour: I may be able to cancel it for you
After 1 hour: cancellations are no longer possible

If you want me to check a specific order, send your order number and I’ll take a look. Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped — can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
it already shipped — can it still be changed?

Hi — once an order has already shipped, it can’t be changed anymore. 📦

That includes things like:

changing the shipping address
adding or removing items
canceling the order

If it’s already been delivered, you can return eligible items and place a new order instead. If you meant a shipping address issue specifically, you can file a shipping claim at claims.simplemodern.com.

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
